title: Foundation Placement on the Potato Fields, Plane and Axis
purpose: Place Foundation stages into the House, two-field Potato projection, World plane and Axis without classifying whole traditions or institutions as upper/lower, angel/demon, Life/Strife or good/bad.
invariants: A whole Foundation is an inhabitant/history object; only its stages and episodes receive field/plane/direction placements.
Upper/lower location is orientation, not moral rank.
Rooting descent, Strife descent and Fruit return are three different downward movements.
Life/Strife/Repair/Return are episode-level route hypotheses requiring consequence evidence.
Fear/love and angel/demon are optional project-native symbolic lenses; they never replace own-tradition meaning, historical motive, evidence or consequence.
A Foundation may occupy several Rooms because ownership and crosscutting views are different relations; one primary Room still owns the substantive record.

room_owner.question: Which Room owns the Foundation's substantive domain identity?
room_owner.rule: Choose one primary Room; use supporting Rooms for chronology, evidence, culture, law, infrastructure or comparison.

field_stage.question: Which part of the two-field Potato is active at this stage?

values.meaning: material substrate, body, resources, seed compression, first embodiment, local practice or operating base
threshold event that changes what can operate: signature, migration, initiation, incorporation, manifesto, protocol switch, merger, publication, first meeting
integrated principle, constitution, rule-set, shared ideal, canon, standard or transmissible orientation
stage where principle and embodiment are jointly active and neither field alone is sufficient

plane_projection.question: From which reader plane is this stage being inspected?

values.meaning: predecessor roots, buried cause, pressure, provenance, residue, hidden dependency
dated public event, institution, practice, infrastructure, legal effect, observable consequence
integrated principle, ideal, canon, coordination, transmission, future Seed and return orientation

plane_projection.rule: The same Foundation can be read from all three planes without changing ownership.

direction.question: What kind of movement is occurring?

values.meaning: descent into provenance, memory, material base or stable local practice
increasing differentiation, articulation, integration or transmissibility
lateral spread, copies, denominations, chapters, implementations, schools or forks
integrated capacity descending into service, infrastructure, application or renewed planting
episode where recurrence reduces agency, provenance, correction or viable exit
negative recurrence is interrupted and changed into a viable root/sprout path
refoundation, merger, protocol replacement or constitutional revision carrying selected residue forward

route_condition.question: What does the episode reproduce?
route_condition.evidence_rule: Do not assign Life/Strife from stated motive, vertical direction or identity. Require observed effects on agency, correction, capability, dependency, externalities and return.

motive_lens.question: What motive/affect is emphasized in project interpretation?

symbolic_bridge.angelic: May be used project-natively for messenger, aid, protection, guidance or generative transmission where appropriate.
symbolic_bridge.demonic: May be used project-natively for adversarial capture, fear-lock, deception or destructive recurrence where evidence supports the mechanism.
symbolic_bridge.guard: Never call a religion, people, institution, political movement or opponent angelic/demonic as a factual or moral identity.

canonical_stage_projection.note: What existed, failed, was lost, became insufficient or was compressed before the crossing.
The most concrete threshold: migration, signature, first meeting, incorporation, declaration, protocol switch, merger, publication or initiation.

canonical_stage_projection.stage: Seed of Life / first viable operation
canonical_stage_projection.note: A reproducible practice obtains a body, place, procedure, text, protocol or community.
The Foundation can now be stated, taught, interpreted or coordinated beyond one event.
The pattern produces chapters, schools, implementations, denominations, forks, copies or successor institutions.
Claims of mature ascent are tested by observable effects, beneficiaries, externalities, capability and correction.
The original carrier may close, fail, lose reproduction or leave residue. Direction is typed from mechanism, not assumed.
Selected residue crosses another threshold into a revised operating platform.

navigation_rule: Foundation cards and timelines should first show owner, time/place and Door genealogy; field/plane/direction controls are secondary views so navigation follows evidence before symbolism.
